lounges.title: Waiting lounge
lounges.text: Premium comfort lounge on Level 2 of the terminal. Open from 6:00 to 12:00, on Friday and Sunday until 14:00, at other times on request to sop@aerobratsk.ru. Free for Business Standard, Business Plus and Economy Plus fares, Gold and Platinum tiers, ON PASS and Grey Wall Pass. Others pay 2,200 ₽ for 3 hours.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: AeroBratsk hotel 350 m from the terminal. A bed in a triple room from 900 ₽ per day, a single room from 3,500 ₽. Breakfast 600 ₽; guests get 20% off lunch in the terminal canteen.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Free car park with 80 spaces on the station forecourt, 8 of them for people with disabilities. Long-stay parking from 300 ₽ per day. Warming up a car in winter costs 4,200 ₽ for 20 minutes, battery charging 2,100 ₽.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi for passengers and airport visitors. Login with identification, as required by law.
